ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_rankgap_clamped_exp
ir.intuition: This loss shifts to a pairwise rank-regularization paradigm using the rank gap signal combined with a clamped exponential penalty on the difference in log probabilities. It encourages the model to assign higher log probabilities to sequences that have a better rank (lower rank number), by scaling the log-probability gap with the clamped exp of the negative rank gap, penalizing inversions more strongly while dampening outliers.
ir.pseudocode:
rank_gap_clamped = clamp(rank_gap, min=1, max=20)
exp_penalty = exp(-rank_gap_clamped)
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss_per_pair = softplus(-score_diff * exp_penalty)
if weight is not None:
  loss = mean(loss_per_pair * weight)
else:
  loss = mean(loss_per_pair)
return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    rank_clamped = ops.clamp(delta_rank, min=1.0, max=20.0)
    exp_penalty = ops.exp(ops.neg(rank_clamped))
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    loss_per_pair = ops.softplus(ops.neg(ops.mul(score_diff, exp_penalty)))
    if weight is not None:
        loss_per_pair = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
